definition_en: an act of saying goodbye, or a parting wish of good fortune
core_image: 月台上，两个朋友拥抱后挥手，列车缓缓启动
scene: 毕业那天，学生们向老师挥手告别。 The students waved farewell to their teacher.
sceneCN: 这里 farewell 是「告别」（第 1 个义项）；句意：学生们向老师挥手告别。

senses.title: Act of parting
senses.definition: the act of saying goodbye to someone who is leaving
senses.definitionCN: 向即将离开的人道别的行为
senses.example: They said their farewells at the station.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在车站道别。
senses.why: The core sense is the moment of parting.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是分别的时刻。

senses.title: Parting event
senses.definition: a party or ceremony held for someone who is leaving
senses.definitionCN: 为即将离开的人举行的聚会或仪式
senses.example: The office held a farewell for her.
senses.exampleCN: 办公室为她举办了告别会。
senses.why: The goodbye becomes an organized occasion.
senses.whyCN: 道别变成有组织的场合。

senses.title: Parting greeting
senses.definition: a word said when leaving, wishing someone well
senses.definitionCN: 离开时说的话，祝愿对方安好
senses.example: Farewell, and good luck!
senses.exampleCN: 再见，祝你好运！
senses.why: The wish for good travel becomes a single greeting.
senses.whyCN: 对旅途顺利的祝愿变成一个问候语。

intro.en: Farewell joins fare, to journey, and well, a wish for good fortune.
intro.cn: farewell 由 fare（旅行）与 well（安好）组合而成，意为祝愿旅途顺利。

items.en: Faran meant to journey; wel meant well.
items.cn: faran 意为旅行；wel 意为好。

items.en: Fare wel was said as a parting wish.
items.cn: fare wel 作为分别祝愿使用。

items.en: Farewell became one word for a goodbye.
items.cn: farewell 合为一个词表示告别。

items.en: Farewell parties and speeches became common.
items.cn: 告别会和告别演说变得常见。

items.en: Farewell is formal and slightly literary.
items.cn: 现代英语中 farewell 较正式且略带文学色彩。

note.en: Farewell is compared with similar forms and with other parting words.
note.cn: 把 farewell 与形近形式以及其他告别用语作比较。

normalIntro.en: Farewell literally means travel well, a wish for the road ahead.
normalIntro.cn: farewell 字面意为「一路安好」，是对前路的祝愿。

normal.en: Farewell is fare plus well, travel well.
normal.cn: farewell 是 fare 加 well，意为旅途安好。

normal.en: Bid farewell is a formal way to say goodbye.
normal.cn: bid farewell 是正式的道别说法。

normal.en: A farewell party marks a departure.
normal.cn: 告别会标志一次离开。

normal.en: Farewell is stronger and more formal than bye.
normal.cn: farewell 比 bye 更强烈也更正式。

normal.en: The plural farewells means several goodbyes.
normal.cn: 复数 farewells 意为多次道别。

abstract.en: Every farewell holds a wish for the journey ahead.
abstract.cn: 每一次告别都包含对前路的祝愿。

abstract.en: Saying farewell makes an ending visible.
abstract.cn: 告别让一个结束变得可见。

abstract.en: The word is a small gift of good fortune.
abstract.cn: 这个词是祝愿对方好运的小礼物。

examples.en: We bade her farewell at the airport.
examples.cn: 我们在机场向她道别。

examples.en: The team held a farewell dinner for the coach.
examples.cn: 球队为教练举办了告别晚宴。

examples.en: He waved farewell from the train window.
examples.cn: 他从火车窗口挥手告别。

dict_mnemonic.text: fare 是「旅行」，well 是「安好」，farewell 即「祝你旅途安好」，用作告别语。

root: 由 fare（旅行）与 well（安好）组成的中古英语告别语，核心义「祝前路顺利的分别」。

sensesIntro.en: Farewell means the act of parting, a parting event, or a formal word of goodbye.
sensesIntro.cn: farewell 意为告别行为、告别活动，或正式的再见用语。

core.en: A parting wish for the other's journey.
core.cn: 对他人旅途的分别祝愿。

branches.en: The act of saying goodbye.
branches.cn: 说道别的行为。

branches.en: A gathering held for a departing person.
branches.cn: 为离开者举行的聚会。

branches.en: The spoken word of parting.
branches.cn: 说出口的告别语。

branches.en: The act and the word happen together.
branches.cn: 告别行为与告别语同时发生。

branches.en: A private goodbye can become a public event.
branches.cn: 私人的道别可以成为公开活动。

intro.en: Farewell is a compound of two native English words.
intro.cn: farewell 是两个英语本族词构成的复合词。

latinIntro.en: Farewell is Germanic, so no Latin root is listed.
latinIntro.cn: farewell 属日耳曼语，因此不列拉丁词根。

items.meaning: to journey or a travel price

items.example: He gave a short farewell speech.
items.exampleCN: 他作了简短的告别演说。

items.example: The soup was done to a fare-thee-well.

definition_en: to plant seeds in the ground or to spread an idea or feeling
core_image: 农人弯着腰，把种子一把把撒进翻好的土里
scene: 农民在春天播种小麦。 The farmer sows wheat in spring.
sceneCN: 这里 sow 是「播种」（第 1 个义项）；句意：农民在春天播种小麦。

senses.title: To plant seeds
senses.definition: to put seeds in the ground so they can grow
senses.definitionCN: 把种子放进土里使其生长
senses.example: The farmer sows wheat in spring.
senses.exampleCN: 农民在春天播种小麦。
senses.why: This is the central farming sense of the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词最核心的农耕含义。

senses.title: To seed a field
senses.definition: to plant a field or piece of land with seeds
senses.definitionCN: 在田地或土地上播种
senses.example: They sowed the field with barley.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在田里种了大麦。
senses.why: The object can be the seed or the ground.
senses.whyCN: 宾语可以是种子，也可以是土地。

senses.title: To spread an idea
senses.definition: to cause an idea or feeling to begin and spread
senses.definitionCN: 使某种想法或情感产生并传播
senses.example: The speech sowed doubt in their minds.
senses.exampleCN: 这番话在他们心中播下了疑虑。
senses.why: Ideas grow like seeds once they are planted.
senses.whyCN: 想法一旦种下，就像种子一样生长。

intro.en: Sow is an old farming verb shared across Germanic languages.
intro.cn: sow 是一个古老的农耕动词，通行于日耳曼语族。

items.en: Sawan meant to scatter seed.
items.cn: sawan 意为撒种。

items.en: The form became sowen.
items.cn: 词形变为 sowen。

items.en: The verb kept the farming sense.
items.cn: 这个动词保留了农耕含义。

items.en: It extended to sowing doubt and discord.
items.cn: 它扩展到「播下疑虑与不和」。

items.en: Reap what you sow fixed it as a proverb.
items.cn: reap what you sow 把它固定为谚语。

note.en: Sow is compared with look-alike words and planting words.
note.cn: 把 sow 与形近词以及表示种植的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: To sow is to trust the ground with the future.
normalIntro.cn: 播种，就是把未来托付给土地。

normal.en: The farmer sows wheat in spring.
normal.cn: 农民在春天播种小麦。

normal.en: They sowed the field with barley.
normal.cn: 他们在田里种了大麦。

normal.en: The speech sowed doubt in their minds.
normal.cn: 这番话在他们心中播下了疑虑。

normal.en: You reap what you sow.
normal.cn: 种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。

normal.en: She sowed seeds along the garden wall.
normal.cn: 她沿着园墙撒下种子。

abstract.en: Sow is a verb that believes in tomorrow.
abstract.cn: sow 是一个相信明天的动词。

abstract.en: Words are seeds, and the ear is soil.
abstract.cn: 言语是种子，耳朵是土壤。

abstract.en: What is sown in secret grows in the open.
abstract.cn: 暗中播下的，会在明处长出。

examples.en: The farmer sows wheat in spring.
examples.cn: 农民在春天播种小麦。

examples.en: They sowed the field with barley.
examples.cn: 他们在田里种了大麦。

examples.en: The speech sowed doubt in their minds.
examples.cn: 这番话在他们心中播下了疑虑。

dict_mnemonic.text: sow 与 sew（缝）同音，注意区分；过去式 sowed，过去分词 sown；sow seeds 是「播种」，sow doubt 是「散布疑虑」，reap what you sow 是「种瓜得瓜」。

root: 来自古英语 sawan（撒种），属日耳曼语族，核心义由田间播种扩展到播下想法与情感。

sensesIntro.en: Sow means to plant seeds, to seed a field, or to spread an idea.
sensesIntro.cn: sow 意为播种、在田里播种，或播下某种想法。

core.en: A hand opening over dark soil.
core.cn: 一只手在深色土壤上方张开。

branches.en: Seeds fall in a small arc.
branches.cn: 种子落成一道小弧线。

branches.en: A whole field is marked for barley.
branches.cn: 整块田被划出来种大麦。

branches.en: A word lands in a listening mind.
branches.cn: 一句话落进倾听的心里。

branches.en: The seed and the field are two halves of one act.
branches.cn: 种子与田地，是同一动作的两半。

branches.en: Ground and mind both wait for what is sown.
branches.cn: 土地与心智，都在等待被播下东西。

intro.en: Sow forms an irregular participle and a pair of nouns.
intro.cn: sow 有不规则过去分词，并构成两个名词。

latinIntro.en: Sow has no Latin root; it comes from Old English sawan.
latinIntro.cn: sow 没有拉丁词根，它来自古英语 sawan。

definition_en: to tie things together, or to place an obligation on someone
core_image: 麻绳把一摞纸箱牢牢捆住
scene: 麻绳把纸箱牢牢捆在一起。 They bound the boxes with rope.
sceneCN: 这里 bind 是「捆绑」（第 1 个义项：用绳带把东西系在一起）；句意是他们用绳子把箱子捆好。

derivatives.zh: 由 bind 加 -ing 构成，义为「有约束力的」
由 bind 加 -er 构成，义为「装订工、活页夹」
由 un- 加 bind 构成，义为「解开」

senses.title: To tie together
senses.definition: to tie things together with rope or string
senses.definitionCN: 用绳或带把东西系在一起
senses.example: They bound the boxes with rope.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用绳子把箱子捆好。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, working with hands and rope.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，用双手与绳索完成。

senses.title: To fasten pages into a book
senses.definition: to fasten pages together as a book
senses.definitionCN: 把书页固定成册
senses.example: The pages were bound in leather.
senses.exampleCN: 书页被装订上皮面。
senses.why: Binding a book is tying pages the way rope ties boxes.
senses.whyCN: 装订书就是像捆箱子那样把书页系住。

senses.title: To place an obligation
senses.definition: to place a legal or moral duty on someone
senses.definitionCN: 给某人加上法律或道义上的义务
senses.example: The contract binds both sides.
senses.exampleCN: 这份合同对双方都有约束力。
senses.why: A promise ties a person the way rope ties a load.
senses.whyCN: 承诺把人系住，就像绳子系住货物。

intro.cn: bind 是日耳曼语中表示「系、捆」的古老动词。
